DML.SELECT: SELECT i.incident_report_id as "id", i.alias as "alias", i.description as "description", i.incident_type_id as "incidentTypeId", i.incident_type_cause_id as "incidentTypeCauseId", i.affection_stretch_id as "affectionStretchId", i.location_id as "locationId", i.incident_state_id as "incidentStateId", i.incident_level_id as "incidentLevelId", i.current_user_id as "currentUserId", i.valid_for_min as "validForMin", i.auto_close_in_min as "autoCloseInMin", i.confirm as "confirm", i.road_impact_id as "roadImpactId", i.enabled as "enabled", i.visible as "visible", i.generated_at as "generatedAt", i.last_update as "lastUpdate", r.management_area_id as "managementAreaId" FROM rt.ims_incident_reports i INNER JOIN conf.stretchs s ON s.stretch_id = i.affection_stretch_id INNER JOIN conf.roads r ON s.road_id = r.road_id WHERE i.enabled = true or i.enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO rt.ims_incident_reports (incident_report_id, alias, description, incident_type_id, incident_type_cause_id, affection_stretch_id, location_id, incident_state_id, incident_level_id, current_user_id, valid_for_min, auto_close_in_min, confirm, road_impact_id, enabled, visible, last_update, generated_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:id=getNextValFromSec{'rt.last_incident_report_id'}, :alias, :description, :incidentTypeId, :incidentTypeCauseId, :affectionStretchId, :locationId, :incidentStateId, :incidentLevelId, :currentUserId, :validForMin, :autoCloseInMin, :confirm, :roadImpactId, :enabled, :visible, :lastUpdate, :generatedAt, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.UPDATE: UPDATE rt.ims_incident_reports SET alias = :alias, description = :description, incident_type_id = :incidentTypeId, incident_type_cause_id = :incidentTypeCauseId, affection_stretch_id = :affectionStretchId, location_id = :locationId, incident_state_id = :incidentStateId, incident_level_id = :incidentLevelId, current_user_id = :currentUserId, valid_for_min = :validForMin, auto_close_in_min = :autoCloseInMin, confirm = :confirm, road_impact_id = :roadImpactId, enabled = :enabled, visible = :visible, last_update = :lastUpdate, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE incident_report_id = :id
